title: Radial Poincaré homotopy formula (Simon 6.2.25 for h(t, x) = tx at the level of forms): K_{m+1}β is C^∞ and d(K_{m+1}β) + K_{m+2}(dβ) = β
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let β : ℝ^P → Λ^{m+1}(ℝ^P) be a C^∞ (m+1)-form on ℝ^P = Euclid P (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1) with ContDiff ℝ ∞ β, written ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β). For x ∈ ℝ^P and a (k+1)-covector α let ι_xα := α.curryLeft x, the k-covector (v_1, …, v_k) ↦ α(x, v_1, …, v_k). Define the m-form Kβ and the (m+1)-form K(dβ) by the interval integrals over [0, 1] (in the complete normed spaces Covector (Euclid P) m and Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)):
(Kβ)(x) := ∫_0^1 t^m • ι_x(β(t x)) dt and (K dβ)(x) := ∫_0^1 t^{m+1} • ι_x(dβ(t x)) dt,
where d = exteriorDerivative (Mathlib extDeriv). Then (i) Kβ is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), and (ii) d(Kβ)(x) + (K dβ)(x) = β(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P. (This is the radial Poincaré homotopy formula β = d(K_pβ) + K_{p+1}(dβ), p = m + 1 ≥ 1.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) β → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m • (β (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y : Euclid P => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m • (β (t • y)).curryLeft y) x + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (m + 1) • (exteriorDerivative β (t • x)).curryLeft x = β x
